+title: 'MTP: let the Qwen drafter cache continue from a cached prefix'
+---
+## What
+Today `Qwen35MTPDraftModel.prepareDrafterState` (Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/Qwen35MTP.swift) sets `state.nextPosition = 0` and fills the drafter cache from the prompt of the current call only. `MTPSpeculativeTokenIterator.init` (Libraries/MLXLMCommon/MTPSpeculativeTokenIterator.swift) always makes a new `MTPDrafterState`. If the caller gives a main cache that already holds a prefix, the drafter does not have that prefix. Its positions are then wrong and its acceptance is low.
+
+Define and implement one alignment contract:
+- Drafter entry j is `(token j+1, target hidden j)`. When the main cache holds P tokens, the drafter cache holds P-1 entries.
+- `LMOutput.State` carries the target hidden row of the last main position under a new key (for example `mtpPendingHiddenKey`, in Libraries/MLXLMCommon/MTPDrafterModel.swift). This row lets the next prefill add drafter entry P-1 without a new run of the target.
+
+Changes:
+- [ ] Add the pending-hidden key and an `MTPDrafterState.processedTokenCount` that is equal to `nextPosition`, in MTPDrafterModel.swift.
+- [ ] Change `prepareDrafterState` so that it appends at `state.nextPosition` and uses the pending hidden row as the hidden of the first new entry. It must not reset to 0.
+- [ ] Let `MTPSpeculativeTokenIterator.init` accept an optional existing `MTPDrafterState` and the incoming `LMOutput.State`. Add the same parameters to the `generate(...mtpDrafter:)` and `generateTokens(...mtpDrafter:)` overloads in Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Evaluate.swift (~2690-2790). Expose the final drafter state and model state so that a caller can continue.
+- [ ] At the end of generation (`finalizeGeneration`), keep the contract: drafter = main - 1, and the pending hidden is the row of the last kept main position.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Two calls, where the second continues the main and drafter caches of the first, give the same greedy tokens as one cold MTP call on the full prompt. They also give the same greedy tokens as plain decode.
+- [ ] On the continued call, the acceptance rate is within 2 points of the cold call.
+- [ ] `qwen38FourBitMTPGeneration` decode tok/s does not drop by more than noise (±3%) against the baseline (math 52.3, code 43.4, prose 26.3 tok/s).
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Tests/MLXLMTests/Qwen35MTPTests.swift: a new test with a small random Qwen35 fixture and an MTP head. It runs prompt A, then continues with suffix B on the returned caches, and compares with a cold run of A+B and with plain greedy.
+- [ ] A unit test for the drafter-count invariant after rounds that accept all drafts and rounds that reject drafts.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests && xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXLMTests.xctest` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #mtp #qwen38
